title: 才 vs 就 Step 7 · Boss Level: Early Bird 小张, Late 小王
description: One Saturday, two friends, every kind of 才 and 就. Who was early, who was late, who's young, and who ate how much?

points.title: Reading 才 and 就 in a story
points.summary: For each 才 / 就: early or late? little or much? which pattern?
points.body:
The feelings tell the story.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: Xiao Zhang was there by half past nine.

questions.translation: Xiao Lin has two friends, Xiao Zhang and Xiao Wang. Last Saturday they agreed to meet in the park at ten. Xiao Zhang was there by half past nine; Xiao Wang didn't turn up until eleven. Xiao Wang said: 'I've only just got up!' Xiao Zhang said: 'As long as you came, that's fine.' The moment they reached the restaurant they ordered. Xiao Wang is only twenty, and he ate three bowls of rice on his own. ★ Xiao Zhang came early.

options: 就 = sooner/easier (usually with 了); 才 = later/harder (no 了); 只要…就, 只有…才, 一…就.
就 and 才 mean the same.
questions.explanation: 🐇 就 = sooner, easier · 🐢 才 = later, harder.
notes: 才 never takes 了 at the end.
